verdict.rationale: Orama's docs say hybrid search performs full-text and vector search in one query and combines the results, which is exactly this story. The GitHub README and the Cloud docs both list hybrid search, and the embeddings plugin generates vectors at insert and search time to support it. Missing for 10: documentation of the fusion or weighting method and any tuning controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hybrid search — semantic vector similarity fused with keyword matching — in a single query

citations.quote: Hybrid search is an Orama feature that allows you to perform full-text and vector search in one unique query, combining the results to get the best of both worlds.
This plugin generates embeddings for your documents at insert and search time, allowing you to perform vector and hybrid searches on your documents.
Full-text search - Vector search - Hybrid search - AI-powered NLP search
